items.alt_text: Pile of rolled tan voting ballots banded and stacked together, showing how large amounts of data are organized.
items.long_description: This is a color photograph taken at close range of a large pile of paper ballots resting on a light-colored table. The pile fills most of the frame with about two to three dozen individual rolls stacked in several overlapping layers, two to three rolls high. Each ballot is a tan or yellowish sheet of paper rolled into a loose horizontal tube, with open circular ends facing the viewer at various angles. The paper edges are worn and slightly tattered with orange-brown borders, and the interior of each roll shows layered paper with faint printed text and grid marks. Many rolls are secured around the middle with a white paper band or tape. Rolls in the foreground are in sharp focus, revealing the spiral layers and texture of the paper and the dark hollow interiors, while rolls and the background toward the top of the image are softly blurred, suggesting an indoor space. Bright light reflects off the upper surfaces of some rolls. Centered across the middle of the image is a semi-transparent black bar with white capitalized text that reads "DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS". A narrow vertical yellow strip runs along the left edge of the image and a thin dark teal strip runs along the top edge. The image illustrates a large quantity of similar items grouped and bundled together for counting and organization.
